Tycho Horan is a book designer, printer, and teacher. She cofounded the Binch Press / Queer.Archive.Work studio (Binch/QAW) and the Queer/Trans Zinefest (QTZ). She is currently teaching at RISD Graphic Design and SMFA Print and Paper.

This website was designed by Tycho Horan. It was coded on Sublime Text, hosted on GitHub, and compiled using the Siteleaf CMS and Jekyll. The site is typeset in Interlope (designed by Gabriel Dubourg and distributed by Velvetyne) and IBM Plex Mono. These works were made in collaboration with many other artists, so please do not reuse or distribute these images without my writen consent. This website was last updated in June 2026.
